bio: Located on the stunning Wellington Estate in the village of Stratfield Turgis, Hampshire, The Wellington Arms is a beautifully refurbished family-friendly pub and hotel, near Hook and Basingstoke.  A delectable selection of sweet treats and savoury delights await, complete with freshly baked scones, clotted cream and preserves.  Why not book your own private Afternoon Tea party, hosted in the characterful surroundings of the restaurant spaces and rose garden, or for smaller parties, private dining rooms, The Snug and The Wellesley Room.  The menu includes the highest quality, seasonal, farm to table ingredients packed into traditional Afternoon Tea delights.  Afternoon Tea is served Monday to Saturday, from 12pm - 5pm and advance booking is recommended.
